item.text: The main gaps are user lookup by ID and payment reads. Order reads already check each order’s `deleted_at`, but they can still expose orders owned by a deleted user. I’ll make those reads honor the parent user and order state too, so list and report results stay consistent.

The filtering and endpoint are in place. Payments now also have a deleted fixture so tests can catch payment filtering directly. I’ve added tests for deleted users, orders, and payments, plus the new route; I’m running the full checks now.

Added soft-delete filtering across user, order, and payment reads, including records linked to deleted users or orders. Database access in services now goes through repositories. The full suite passed: **37 tests**, plus lint and checks for all 7 routes.
